description_en: This operation is no longer maintained. Starting immediately, new enterprises should use the Create Enterprise Employee, Modify Enterprise Employee Information, and Modify Enterprise Employee Employment Status operations for personnel data maintenance. Calls this operation to add employee information, modify employee information, or modify the employment status of a specified employee
description_zh:
本接口已停止维护！即日起，新接入企业请使用创建企业员工、修改企业员工信息、修改企业员工在职状态等接口进行人员数据维护。
通过调用本接口可实现新增员工信息、修改员工信息、修改指定员工在职状态等操作
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen isv-user-save --user-list '[{"birthday":"2000-01-01","gender":"M","leave_status":0,"user_name":"张三","third_depart_id_list":["depart_01"],"real_name_en":"John/Wilson","depart_id":1234,"job_no":"job_1234","role_id_list":["role_001"],"third_depart_id":"depart_1234","cert_list":[{"cert_type":0,"cert_no":"110101000000001234","nationality":"CN","cert_nation":"CN","cert_expired_time":"2050-01-01"}],"user_nick":"三儿","base_city_code":"330100,310100","manager_user_id":"user_123","is_admin":true,"user_id":"user_1234","phone":"13100008888","position_level":"20","position":"产品经理","email":"j000000000@example.com"}]' --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth0000wls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IsvUserSave

fields.help_en:
The 6-digit administrative code of the work location.
You can specify up to two different administrative codes.
Format: If you need to specify two administrative codes, separate them with a comma ","

工作地 6 位行政编码。
最多传入两个不同的行政编码。
格式要求：若需传入两个行程编码时，请使用英文逗号","进行分隔

fields.help_en:
The mobile phone number of the employee.
Typically used for business travel booking. In this case, this parameter is required.
If your enterprise is a government agency or other special organization, call `400-800-5890` to contact Alibaba Business Travel customer service representative first
fields.help_zh:
员工手机号。
通常用于处理商旅类目预定的业务，此时为必填项。
若您的企业性质为政府机关或其他特殊企业，请先拨打 `400-800-5890` 与阿里商旅客服人员联系

fields.help_en:
The English name of the employee. Specify the value in the following format:
Separate the last name and first name with "/", for example: `LastName/FirstName`.
Do not include spaces between the last name and first name
fields.help_zh:
员工的英文名。请按照以下格式要求进行传值：
英文姓氏与名字间用 "/" 分隔，如：`LastName/FirstName`。
姓氏与名字之间不要留有空格
fields.name: real_name_en

fields.help_en:
The collection of business travel role IDs for the employee.
The number of roles associated with a single employee must be less than or equal to 200. Otherwise, the employee sync will fail
fields.help_zh:
员工的商旅角色 ID 集合。
同一员工关联的角色数要求小于等于200个，否则员工同步不成功

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
When calling this operation via HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain it, see Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending to the URL, you can use any of the following formats: `so_corp_token=value`, `dtb_corp_token=value`, or `corp_token=value`. Recommended: `corp_token=value`
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
使用 HTTP 方式调用接口时需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，可以选择 `so_corp_token=value`、`dtb_corp_token=value` 以及 `corp_token=value` 任一写法，推荐使用 `corp_token=value`
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token
